newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti ranks top in Europe IT services.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti ranks top in Europe IT services.

text.p: Olivetti's computer systems company Olsy is ranked as Europe's leading supplier of distributed information technology services for the fourth year running in 1996, a survey showed on Wednesday.

The report by market research firm Dataquest put Olsy's revenue in this IT area, believed to be the fastest growing segment of the IT services market, at over $900 million last year and its European market share close to six percent.

Olsy's revenue in distributed IT services is put at $908 million for 1996, ahead of second-placed Electronic Data Systems Copr (EDS) at $714.5 million and Hewlett-Packard at $695.5 million, the survey showed.
Olivetti chief executive Roberto Colaninno said the survey highlighted the importance of IT within the Olivetti group, and emphasised Olsy's competitiveness.
"We intend to strengthen this presence by means of international alliances capable of further developing the role of Olsy as a global player," he said in an Olivetti statement.

Olsy, formerly Olivetti systems and services, has projected revenues for 1997 of 4.5 trillion lire ($2.5 billion) and employs around 13,000 people in more than 40 countries. It supplies equipment for the banking sector, public authorities, utilities, retailers and major manufacturers.
